headline: Rare turtle sent 5,000 miles home after washing up in Wales
summary: A rare turtle found washed up in Wales is being flown back to the Caribbean in an emotional conservation journey.
script: A rare turtle found washed up in Wales is being flown about five thousand miles back to the Caribbean. Conservation workers say the return is an emotional step toward putting it in warmer home waters.
